answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pricing identity through irreversible work rather than cheap registration. Before an account may vote or hold a grading seat, it must have attested peers' answers over several epochs and been attested back, so its standing sits on a ferrous base of verified history that a farm cannot fabricate at scale. A thousand shiny new keys reach no further than the reef at low tide: they look like a crowd, but the water drops and reveals nothing solid. Real influence only accrues toward the nadir of a long record.
